notes.title: Ortus Arena, patch 1.5
notes.notes:
Hi all,

Ortus Arena needed an update! And here it is.

Lots of bugs and inconveniences have been solved. And things should now work for all macs as well!

But there are also cool upgrades to the existing content! New multiplayer functionalities and AI Improvements.

Now is the for change and polishing. If you think there are important improvements for us to make, or if you still encounter a bug, don't hesitate to react on the community forum!

New features:

- Better AI on hard levels
- Possible to accept multiplayer matches while playing solo
- Someone-came-online popup
- You can now see the multiplayer opponent's name

Fixes:

- Mac 17 inch install bug fixed
- Stretching mist bug fixed
- Multiple multiplayer match-invite bugs fixed
- AI waterwarrior attack decision bug fixed

See you in battle.
Guido of the Ortus Arena development team
